Google Updates Flow Music to Allow Custom VST3 and AU Plugin Export

28 Oct 2026, 12:33 AM IST · GlobalTech Daily Tech Desk · Source: blog.google

Share this article
WhatsAppFacebookTelegram
Key takeaways Customizing Music Production Google has updated its Flow Music platform, allowing creators to generate custom instruments and effects using natural language. Previously limited to browser-based experimentation, users can now export their custom 'Spaces' as VST3 or AU

Customizing Music Production

Google has updated its Flow Music platform, allowing creators to generate custom instruments and effects using natural language. Previously limited to browser-based experimentation, users can now export their custom 'Spaces' as VST3 or AU plugins. This integration enables producers to utilize AI-generated tools directly within standard Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs).

Impact on Workflow

By removing the requirement for traditional coding knowledge, the platform aims to personalize production environments. Industry professionals, such as producer Khris Riddick-Tynes, have already utilized these capabilities to develop tools aimed at maintaining studio-quality audio standards across various recording environments.

Verification and Availability

Users can explore the current features and toolsets by visiting the official Google Labs announcement. Readers are encouraged to test the workflow capabilities through the platform interface to determine compatibility with their existing music production setups.

Source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/create-music-production-plugins-google-flow/
